# Format properties: Bar and column charts

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Clustered column chart, Stacked column chart, 100% stacked column chart, Clustered bar chart, Stacked bar chart, 100% stacked bar chart), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/bar-and-column-charts.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clustered column chart | `clusteredColumnChart` | 10 | 122 |
| Stacked column chart | `columnChart` | 11 | 130 |
| 100% stacked column chart | `hundredPercentStackedColumnChart` | 10 | 122 |
| Clustered bar chart | `clusteredBarChart` | 10 | 122 |
| Stacked bar chart | `barChart` | 11 | 130 |
| 100% stacked bar chart | `hundredPercentStackedBarChart` | 10 | 122 |
